# Vendored code

- `js-yaml.min.js` — [js-yaml](https://github.com/nodeca/js-yaml) 4.1.0, the YAML reader the cart parser calls. MIT, see `LICENSE-js-yaml.txt`. This is the unmodified minified build as published on cdnjs (sha256 `45dc3dd0…7f07ebd7`); `public/index.html` carries the same bytes in an inline `<script>` so the page loads nothing from a CDN.
